name: data-engineering-skills
description: Skills for data engineering, software quality, architecture, and agent-assisted workflows.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: How code gets written and checked: architectural baselines, Python standards, and the defect and structure reviews that gate a finished change. Invoke as /craft:<skill-name>. The architecture-baseline skill requires the separately installed researcher agent.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: How work gets driven from an unformed idea to something tracked and built: exploring, pressure-testing, delegating implementation, ticketing, and capture. Invoke as /flow:<skill-name>. The scout skill requires the separately installed pathfinder and researcher agents; orchestrate requires implementer, pathfinder, and researcher.

plugins.name: data
plugins.description: The warehouse surface: canonical SQL standards for trustworthy analytics, and Snowflake ACCOUNT_USAGE auditing for masking, row access, classification, tags, grants, logins, and query history. Invoke as /data:<skill-name>.
